name: Clara Dupont
subject: Hiking Mount Bromo Safety & Prep
message: Hello! Is it necessary to hire a local guide if we plan to climb up to Mount Bromo's caldera rim on foot, or is the trail self-explanatory? Also, does the national park provide masks for the sulfur fumes, or should we buy them in advance? Thank you!
emailLog: Connecting to SMTP server at smtp.gmail.com:587...
Subject: [WANDERLUSH ADMIN] New Inquiry from Clara Dupont

replies.message: Hello Clara, the hiking path up Bromo's crater rim is quite straightforward from the sea of sand, but we recommend a local guide for cultural commentary and hidden viewpoints. For masks, sulfur fumes can be strong, so we highly recommend bringing N95/FFP2 masks in advance, though locals sell basic ones at the crater base. Let us know if we can arrange a private trek for you!
